name: cache
description: Shows how long each subagent's prompt cache has left, and stops Claude waking a large agent whose cache has expired without weighing a fresh start.

ttl_seconds.title: Cache lifetime (seconds)
ttl_seconds.description: Overrides the cache lifetime. Left empty, it is 3600 when subagentPromptCacheTtl is 1h and 300 otherwise.

min_tokens.title: Guard threshold (tokens)
min_tokens.description: The guard stops a message only to an agent holding at least this many tokens.

log_events.title: Log guard decisions
log_events.description: Appends one line per guard decision to ~/.claude/logs/cache/guard.jsonl.

main_view.title: Countdown in the main view
main_view.description: Shows the agents whose cache is still alive above the prompt in the main conversation. Each agent's own view shows its countdown either way.
